_about: Hand-checked against bioforensics/lusSTR at 2425112706d03929ee3cf82588ddd6a2f315083c (tag 0.11) on 2026-09-29, from README.md (the only user document: no docs/ folder and no wiki), Makefile, setup.py, lusSTR/cli/__init__.py, lusSTR/cli/strs.py, lusSTR/cli/config.py, lusSTR/workflows/strs.smk and lusSTR/data/config.yaml at that commit, api.anaconda.org and the 0.11 release.

install.documented: conda install -c bioconda lusstr ('for best results'); contributors: create a conda env, git clone, make devenv (which runs pip install -e .)

published.where: README.md:35-38 (conda install -c bioconda lusstr); https://api.anaconda.org/package/bioconda/lusstr (versions 0.1.1 to 0.11; 0.11 is a noarch build uploaded 2025-06-17); https://github.com/bioforensics/lusSTR/releases/tag/0.11 (no assets)

extra_inputs.what: config.yaml in the working directory, written by `lusstr config` (analysis_software uas/straitrazor/genemarker, samp_input, kit forenseq/powerseq, output_type strmix/efm/mpsproto, ...). The Snakemake workflow reads it, and it must point samp_input at the input reports

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: lusSTR does not read sequencing reads or alignments. Its STR workflow takes UAS Sample Details or Sample Reports (.xlsx), STRait Razor v3 per-sample output (made with the ForenSeqv1.27 or PowerSeqv2.31 configs), GeneMarker v2.6 *_strresults_filtered.csv, or a CSV with Locus, NumReads, Sequence and SampleID columns. STRhub holds no such dataset. Its ForenSeq FASTQ would first have to go through STRait Razor, a different tool.

notes: Main analysis: `lusstr strs all`. It runs the Snakemake STR workflow format -> convert -> filter ('all' is a positional target, lusSTR/cli/strs.py:28-34) in a working directory that already holds config.yaml from `lusstr config`; -w sets that directory (README.md:119). Other entry points: `lusstr snps all` (the SNP workflow) and `lusstr gui` (a Streamlit GUI, README.md:49-58). The filter step writes input files for EuroForMix, MPSproto or STRmix. README.md:30 still calls 0.9 'the most recent lusSTR version' at tag 0.11. Plain `make` only prints help; `make devenv` is the developer install and amounts to pip install -e . in a conda env, hence 'pip'. Input kinds are labels, not file extensions: uas_report is .xlsx, straitrazor_report is STRait Razor .txt, genemarker_report and allele_table are .csv. Platform: ForenSeq Signature Prep and Kintelligence, and PowerSeq, are Illumina (MiSeq) kits; the README names the kits, not the sequencer.
